text: Skyward Group, the front-of-jersey sponsor of USA Rugby's national teams, is the unified holding-company brand of Skyward Specialty Insurance Group, Inc., a Nasdaq-listed US specialty insurer (SKWD) whose businesses include Skyward Specialty and Apollo. Its 2026 proxy statement lists BlackRock (6.35%), James Hays (6.33%), Reinhart Partners (5.43%), Vanguard (5.1%) and Capital International Investors (5%) as its only 5%-or-more shareholders.

source.name: Skyward Specialty Insurance Group: 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A), Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management (SEC EDGAR)
